title: The Falcon and the Partridge
logline: A falcon who cannot reach a partridge in its thorny nest talks it out with sweet promises, seizes and eats it, and is destroyed by his own meal while a grape-eating fox watches the whole hunt from a distance.
moral: Sweet words from a known hunter are bait; and a meal won by deceit can poison the one who eats it.
tone: A dark fable told with dry comedy: the comedy lives in the falcon's mask slipping on and off and in the fox's reactions; the seizure and the curse are played straight and without gore; the comeuppance is slapstick (falling feathers) ending in stillness.

beats.summary: A hungry fox enters an orchard: he is our witness for the whole story.
He finds ripe grapes and settles to eat.
A falcon chases a small partridge across the sky.
The partridge escapes into its nest among thorny branches.
The falcon cannot reach it by force.
He changes his method: the mask of kindness goes on.
He claims he came to help and to bring food.
The partridge has seen the talons and does not believe him.
The partridge asks the unanswerable question: then why were you chasing me?
The falcon promises plenty of grain on the ground (the ground is bare).
He swears he means no harm, claws crossed behind his back.
After long listening the partridge lets its doubt go.
It leaves the nest and edges toward him.
The falcon seizes it and lifts it from the ground.
Too late it understands: the promises were a trick.
The curse: may my flesh be poison to you.
The falcon eats, sure it was an easy meal.
His strength goes and his feathers fall out.
He cannot fly, falls and dies on the spot.
The fox, who saw it all, weighs how a hunt begun with cunning and promises ended, and goes on his way.

sets.description: One 1600 x 1230 world, ground y 900, composed from Library sky (day, then dusk after the LATER card), sun, cloudFlat, hillTrees, ground, bush and tree(), plus three new pieces. (1) Grape trellis on the left: posts at x 120 and x 470 (24 wide, y 560..900), beam y 548..572, vine leaves along the beam, five grape bunches hanging at (170,650) (250,690) (330,745) (400,680) (450,640). (2) Dead snag: a broken grey-brown trunk at x 820, 90 wide at the base, flat top 120 wide at y 430, two short stubs. (3) Nest tree: trunk centre x 1355, 110 wide, crown blobs around (1355, 300) radius 190; a bare perch branch 22 thick running left from the trunk at y 640 to x 1010; the thorn nook in the fork at (1290, 600): a cage of crossing thorny twigs 190 wide x 150 tall with a gap 80 wide facing left (bars at x 1215..1235), drawn in a back layer and a front layer so the partridge sits inside; the Library nest at (1290, 640). All positions are plan values; adjust on the set and keep the relations (falcon cannot reach; snag between fox and tree).

props.description: Library nest, no eggs, inside the thorn nook at (1290, 640).

grapeBunch(ctx, x, y, {n, eaten, swing}): inverted triangle of 10 to 14 purple circles (r 11, colour #6a2c91 with one white highlight dot each and blue halftone on the shadow side), 46 wide x 70 tall, green stem and one leaf; eaten 0..1 removes grapes from the bottom.

featherFall effect: single feathers (leaf shape 26 x 8 with a centre line, colour by owner: partridge sandy, falcon slate) that see-saw down on a seeded path and come to rest; also a ground pile of n feathers.

scenes.summary: Before it dies the partridge shouts its anger: you deceived me with words and showed friendship while you meant to kill me; may my flesh be poison to you, and may you be repaid.

scenes.composition: Falcon fills the left and top of the frame; the partridge, pinned at the bottom right of the snag top, shouts up at him. Icons appear in the sky to the right, clear of both faces.

actions.action: raises his head high, beak open, ready to strike
actions.acting: slow lift 0.8 s then a hold; shadow of his head over the partridge

actions.action: shuts its eyes
actions.acting: lid 1, tremble, one breath

actions.action: eyes snap open, brow V, and it shouts up at him
actions.acting: beak 1.7, headRot -0.5, sound arcs from the beak

actions.action: checks his strike and pulls his head back, blinking
actions.acting: surprised: brow up, head recoil with settleTo

actions.action: struggles half up on one wing under his foot
actions.acting: body lifts 10 units against the grip

actions.action: anger flush: red dots climb its face
actions.acting: flush 0 to 1, feathers bristle (puff)

actions.action: jabs its free wing at him: you tricked me
actions.acting: wing jab on the word, twice

actions.action: mimes his talking beak with its wing tip, opening and closing
actions.acting: bird mime: bla bla, with a sour face

actions.action: the red heart from S4 appears in the sky between them
actions.acting: same drawing, same size: callback

actions.action: the heart turns round: its back is a black claw mark
actions.acting: flip by x scale 1 to -1 in 6 frames

actions.action: points from the heart to his talons
actions.acting: gaze and wing travel heart to foot

actions.action: the heart cracks in two and the halves drop out of frame
actions.acting: crack line, halves fall with fallY

actions.action: shrugs: so what
actions.acting: wings lift and drop, lid 0.6, smirk

actions.action: looks up past him to the sky
actions.acting: gaze [0,-1], wet eyes, voice steadier: brow level

actions.action: lays its wing on its own chest: my flesh
actions.acting: wing to chest, slow

actions.action: a green drop icon with a black X pops beside it; label POISON!
actions.acting: drop wobbles like liquid; pop with overshoot

actions.action: laughs at the idea: HA HA!
actions.acting: head back, belly shakes, eyes shut

actions.action: fixes him with a steady stare; the camera reaches its eyes
actions.acting: no tremble now; lid 0.2, brow V

actions.action: his laugh dries up; one uneasy glance at the green drop
actions.acting: saccade to the icon and back, a small swallow

actions.action: shakes it off and brings his beak down
actions.acting: brow V, head whips down; cut on the motion before contact

scenes.summary: The falcon eats the partridge (seen only as the fox wincing and feathers drifting past) and thinks he has had an easy meal.

camera.notes: Cut to the fox under the trellis (x 330, y 720, zoom 1.6) looking up to the right. At 126.3 pan right and up to the snag (x 820, y 430, zoom 1.9) for the smug falcon.

scenes.composition: The eating happens off-screen to the right. Fox eye line and the drifting feathers carry it. Falcon afterwards sits alone on the snag with a round belly; three partridge feathers lie on the wood.

actions.action: winces at a sound off-screen: eyes shut, ears flat
actions.acting: sq 0.92, head turned half away; GULP! lettering at the right edge of the panel

actions.action: opens one eye a crack toward the snag, then looks down at his grapes
actions.acting: lid 0.7 peek, then gaze down; pushes the grapes away with a paw: appetite gone

actions.action: three small brown feathers drift into the frame from the upper right
actions.acting: see-saw fall, staggered

actions.action: follows one feather down with his eyes until it lands by his paw
actions.acting: lookAt(head, feather); ears droop

actions.action: pan to the snag: the falcon alone, belly round, wiping his beak on the wood, left side then right
actions.acting: belly 1; two wipes; eyes half shut

actions.action: thinks: a small thought cloud with a tick mark
actions.acting: self-satisfied nod

actions.action: pats his belly with a wing
actions.acting: two pats, belly wobbles (sq pulses)

actions.action: a small burp: one puff and one tiny feather out of his beak
actions.acting: head jerk, surprised blink, then a grin

actions.action: settles back, eyes closed, smug; label EASY!
actions.acting: lid 1, smile, slow breathe

scenes.summary: A little later his strength fades, his feathers fall out, and when he tries to fly his wings cannot lift him.

camera.notes: The LATER card covers 130.0 to 131.2; under its midpoint the sky changes to the dusk preset. Medium on the snag (x 820, y 440, zoom 2.0); pull out to zoom 1.5 by 137.4 to show the feathers gathering on the ground; hold for the flight attempt.

scenes.composition: Falcon alone on the snag against the orange dusk sky. Falling feathers fill the space below him; by 142 there is a small pile at the foot of the snag.

actions.action: transition card A LITTLE LATER... ; the sky behind changes from day to dusk
actions.acting: camera key hidden at the card midpoint

actions.action: dozing on the snag, belly out
actions.acting: lid 1, breathe slow

actions.action: a hiccup jolts him awake; his belly glows with green dots
actions.acting: eyes open one then the other; green flush on the belly pulsing

actions.action: tries to stand tall and sways
actions.acting: tip oscillates +-0.08, feet shuffle to catch balance

actions.action: droops: wings sag, head sinks, eyelids heavy
actions.acting: sag 0.8, drop +16, lid 0.6, brow raised and worried

actions.action: one long wing feather lets go; he watches it fall
actions.acting: gaze follows it down; mouth o

actions.action: two more go, then one from the tail
actions.acting: stagger 4 frames

actions.action: a flurry: he snatches at the falling feathers and tries to press one back onto his chest; it falls off again
actions.acting: panic: wide eyes, fast head turns; moult 0 to 0.6 (bald pink patches appear)
actions.library: hawk moult field; featherFall rate up

actions.action: stands half bald and shivering, hugging himself with ragged wings
actions.acting: tremble 2, wet eyes, sq 0.95

actions.action: sets his brow, spreads the ragged wings and crouches to take off
actions.acting: anticipate sq 0.82 for 0.5 s; wing edges full of gaps

actions.action: jumps and flaps frantically; FLAP! FLAP! lettering
actions.acting: flap 16 Hz at half amplitude; rises 40 units only

actions.action: hangs in the air for a moment as more feathers burst out of both wings
actions.acting: eyes to the wings left then right in alarm; moult to 0.85

actions.action: sinks back onto the snag
actions.acting: slow fall 40 units, legs paddling

actions.action: lands on the very edge; one foot slips off and the wings hang like rags
actions.acting: landSquash 0.85, sag 1, head down

actions.action: teeters backward on the edge and looks at the camera
actions.acting: tip to -0.25 and hold; the one lens stare, a gulp

scenes.summary: The falcon falls from the snag and dies where he lands. The fox has watched everything from far off.

camera.notes: Follow the fall from the snag top to the ground (x 780, y 760, zoom 1.6, keys on the fall start and the impact). From 148.0 a long slow pull-out and pan left to zoom 1.0 at x 500, which brings the fox into the left edge by 150.3.

scenes.composition: Final wide: fox small at x 220 on the left, the falcon on his back at x 740 on the right, 500 units of empty ground between them. Nothing in the bottom third but ground.

actions.action: tips over backward off the snag and falls
actions.acting: fallY 470 units with real acceleration (0.55 s), wings trailing up, feathers streaming

actions.action: impact at (740, 900): dust column, feather cloud, THUD! lettering
actions.acting: impactSquash 2 frames deep, panel-only shake

actions.action: small rebound, then settles on his back with his feet in the air
actions.acting: rebound 20 units, settleTo

actions.action: the pile at the foot of the snag is blown outward by the landing
actions.acting: radial drift 40 units, settle

actions.action: his feet stiffen, then go slack; the eyes become two small x marks
actions.acting: legs straight for 6 frames then droop; eyes x; no blood, no wound

actions.action: one last feather see-saws down and lands on his chest
actions.acting: slow, 0.9 s; the only moving thing

actions.action: stillness, then the pull-out begins
actions.acting: dust has cleared; dusk sky
actions.library: camera keys in a pair for the hold

actions.action: pull out and pan left across the empty ground
actions.acting: slow ease

actions.action: the fox is revealed at the left, half behind a trellis post, staring
actions.acting: only the head and one shoulder show (peek from cover); ears forward, eyes wide
actions.library: peek pattern (Fox film): draw fox then the post

actions.action: steps out from behind the post, slowly
actions.acting: two careful steps (walk), neck stretched toward the falcon, tail low

actions.action: blinks twice and swallows
actions.acting: blink keys, small drop pulse of the head

actions.action: hold the full wide: fox far left, falcon far right
actions.acting: the distance is the picture

scenes.summary: The fox thinks over how a hunt begun with cunning and promises ended, then leaves and goes on his way. THE END.

camera.notes: Medium on the fox (x 300, y 720, zoom 1.7) for the thought. From 159.0 widen to zoom 1.0 and track right with him across the orchard (cam x 500 to 1100). After he exits, drift up to the empty nest and the dusk sky (x 1200, y 520) for THE END.

scenes.composition: Thought cloud upper right of the panel, fox lower left. On the walk the fox passes behind the fallen falcon on a farther lane (y 880, s 0.95). End frame: empty nook, dusk sky; the title sits in the sky area.

actions.action: sits down, eyes going from the falcon to the empty nest tree and back
actions.acting: gazePlan: falcon, nest, falcon; ears half down

actions.action: looks at the feather lying by his paw and turns it over with a toe
actions.acting: raise 0.6, gaze down, lid 0.4

actions.action: thought cloud opens: the small falcon on his back, feet up
actions.acting: cloud pops, icon version of the last scene

actions.action: the cloud picture rewinds to the beginning: the smiling falcon with the heart
actions.acting: page flip inside the cloud

actions.action: the smiling face in the cloud gets a sly eyebrow
actions.acting: brow tilts on the word deception

actions.action: the grain heap icon appears beside it, then both pop, leaving one drifting feather
actions.acting: pop, feather falls out of the cloud

actions.action: shakes his head slowly and stands up
actions.acting: two slow shakes, lids low, a breath out (small puff)

actions.action: leaves the grapes behind and starts walking to the right
actions.acting: one look back at the half-eaten bunch, then head forward; walk at 300 units per second

actions.action: passes the fallen falcon on the far side with a wide berth and one sideways glance
actions.acting: gaze to the body for 0.5 s, ears flat, pace does not change; his footfalls make the loose feathers hop

actions.action: trots on past the nest tree and out of the right edge
actions.acting: tail level, ears up again: on his way

actions.action: drifts up from the empty ground to the empty nook in the tree
actions.acting: one feather caught on a thorn flutters

actions.action: THE END title pops in the dusk sky above the tree and holds
actions.acting: pop with overshoot, then still; the feather on the thorn keeps fluttering

ending.description: After the fox trots out of the right edge (about 163.5) the camera drifts up to the empty thorn nook against the dusk sky; one feather caught on a thorn flutters. THE END pops in the sky at 164.0 with a quiet chime at 164.2 and holds to 166.5. The dead falcon is not in the end frame.

subtitles.ar: دخل ثعلب بستانًا يبحث عن الطعام،|ووجد عناقيد عنب ناضجة بين الأغصان.|وبينما كان يأكل، رأى صقرًا يطير سريعًا خلف طائر حجل صغير،|فاختبأ الحجل في عشه بين الشجر.
subtitles.en: A fox entered a garden looking for food|and found ripe grapes.|While eating, it saw a falcon chasing a small partridge,|which hid in its nest among the branches.

subtitles.ar: وقف الصقر قرب العش،|لكنه لم يستطع الوصول إلى الحجل.|فغير طريقته وقال بصوت هادئ: «لماذا تخاف مني؟|أنا لم آت لأؤذيك، بل لأساعدك وأحضر لك الطعام.»
subtitles.en: The falcon perched near the nest|but could not reach the partridge.|So it changed tactics, speaking gently: “Why fear me?|I did not come to harm you but to help you find food.”

subtitles.ar: لم يصدق الحجل الكلام في البداية.|كان قد رأى مخالب الصقر الحادة، وعرف أنه يصطاد الطيور.|فقال من داخل العش:|«لو كنت تريد مساعدتي، فلماذا كنت تطاردني؟»
subtitles.en: At first the partridge did not believe him.|It had seen his sharp talons and knew he hunted birds.|From inside the nest it asked,|“If you wanted to help me, why were you chasing me?”

subtitles.ar: أجاب الصقر بأنه رأى الحجل جائعًا،|وأنه يريد أن يقوده إلى حبوب كثيرة على الأرض.|تكلم بلطف، وأقسم أنه لا ينوي الشر.|استمع الحجل طويلًا، وبدأ الشك يختفي من قلبه.
subtitles.en: The falcon answered that the partridge looked hungry|and he wished to guide it to plentiful grain.|He spoke kindly and swore he meant no harm.|The partridge listened, and its doubts began to fade.

subtitles.ar: أخيرًا خرج الحجل من عشه، واقترب من الصقر بحذر.|لكن الصقر لم ينتظر لحظة أخرى؛|أمسك به بمخالبه القوية، ورفعه عن الأرض.|فهم الحجل متأخرًا أن الوعود الجميلة كانت خدعة.
subtitles.en: At last the partridge left its nest and approached cautiously.|The falcon did not wait:|he seized it in his strong talons and lifted it from the ground.|The bird understood too late that the promises were a trick.

subtitles.ar: وقبل أن يموت، صاح الحجل غاضبًا:|«خدعتني بكلامك، وأظهرت الصداقة وأنت تريد قتلي.|أتمنى أن يصبح لحمي سمًا لك،|وأن تنال جزاء ما فعلت!»
subtitles.en: Before dying, the partridge cried angrily,|“You deceived me with words. You pretended friendship while planning to kill me.|May my flesh become poison to you,|and may you suffer for what you have done!”

subtitles.ar: أكل الصقر الحجل، وظن أنه حصل على وجبة سهلة.|لكن بعد قليل بدأت قوته تضعف،|وأخذ ريشه يتساقط من جسمه.|حاول أن يطير، فلم تستطع جناحاه حمله.
subtitles.en: The falcon ate the partridge, thinking it an easy meal.|Soon his strength faded|and feathers began falling from his body.|He tried to fly, but his wings could no longer lift him.

subtitles.ar: سقط الصقر على الأرض ومات في المكان نفسه.|وكان الثعلب يراقب ما جرى من بعيد،|بعدما شاهد كيف انتهى الصيد الذي بدأ بالمكر والوعود.|ثم ترك المكان ومضى في طريقه.
subtitles.en: The falcon fell to the ground and died on the spot.|The fox had watched from afar|how a hunt begun with deception and promises had ended.|Then it left and continued on its way.

new_assets.name: hawk (bird kind)
new_assets.description: The bird of prey already planned by KD-011 and KD-014, here with a falcon palette (slate back, cream barred chest, black moustache stripe, yellow feet). This story needs the fields brow, mouth (smile, smirk, o), talons 0..1, grip, reach, sit, belly 0..1, moult 0..1 and eyes x.
new_assets.implementation: Add BIRD.hawk palette and branch on P.kind === 'hawk' inside a new raw function hawk() that reuses the bird body ellipses at a longer proportion (body 44 x 28), draws the hooked beak as a 5-point shape, the brow as a thick black wedge rotated by P.brow, feet as three forward toes and one back toe (seg + small triangles) whose curl comes from P.talons; grip closes the toes round a given radius; moult removes wing-edge feather shapes by seeded index and paints pink patches; wrap with acting().

new_assets.name: partridge (bird kind)
new_assets.description: A plump small ground bird as a new kind on the Library bird: sandy body, cream face with black necklace, barred chestnut flank, red beak and legs, no crest.
new_assets.implementation: Add BIRD.partridge palette; in bird() scale the body ellipse x by 1.15 for this kind, draw the necklace as one black stroke and the flank bars as three short segs; legs red. All existing bird fields (fly, flap, drop, headRot, sag, beak, lid, sq, tailDrop) work unchanged. Default look of existing kinds must not change (regression test).

new_assets.name: orchard
new_assets.description: Garden world 1600 wide with a grape trellis, a dead snag and a nest tree with a thorn nook and a perch branch (dimensions in sets).
new_assets.implementation: bake() one background from sky, hillTrees, ground, bush, tree(); trellis from rect posts and beam plus seeded leaf shapes; snag as a tapered shape with brush outline; thorn nook as 9 seeded curved segs with small triangle thorns in two layers (back, front) so a bird can be drawn between them. Bake a day and a dusk version.

new_assets.name: grapeBunch
new_assets.description: Hanging bunch of grapes with eaten 0..1 and swing.
new_assets.implementation: Rows of circles (4, 4, 3, 2, 1) with ctx.arc fills, halftone on one side, stem seg, leaf shape; rotate about the stem top by swing().

new_assets.name: featherFall
new_assets.description: Seeded falling feathers that see-saw, land and pile up; colour and count as parameters; a burst mode for the pounce and the failed flight.
new_assets.implementation: Each feather i: start point and time from a list or K.rng; x = x0 + A sin(w tau + phase), y = y0 + v tau until it reaches its rest y, rot = 0.6 cos(w tau); draw a 26 x 8 leaf shape with a centre line. Pure function of t.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: The planned pictogram balloon (KD-026), single icon mode about 170 x 130 px, with icons grainHeap, chase (falcon icon after bird icon) and an empty/burst state.
new_assets.implementation: Rounded box with a tail from the style box primitive; icon callbacks drawn inside under a clip; burst = 6 fragments flying out over 0.3 s.

new_assets.name: thoughtCloud
new_assets.description: The planned generic thought cloud (used 49.28 to 51.8, 127.32 and 155.26 to 158.9).
new_assets.implementation: Existing cloud(... inside) pattern from the Thief film generalised to thoughtCloud(box, drawInside).

new_assets.name: flush
new_assets.description: The planned flush: red on the angry partridge (109.24), green on the falcon belly (132.12) through a colour parameter.
new_assets.implementation: Halftone dots clipped to the face or belly ellipse, rising with a 0..1 level; colour parameter.

new_assets.name: inset circle
new_assets.description: The planned round picture-in-picture, used twice for the fox reaction (73.9 to 74.8 and 91.46 to 92.0), r 150 at the panel top left.
new_assets.implementation: Clip a circle in panel space, draw the world with a second camera centred on the fox head, black brush ring on top; iris in and out over 5 frames.

new_assets.name: groundShadow
new_assets.description: The planned moving shadow of a flying or perched character on ground and foliage (20.4 and 89.0 to 93.1).
new_assets.implementation: Flattened black ellipse or wing silhouette at alpha 0.25 with halftone, positioned under the character, scale from height.

new_assets.name: fox rear / carry
new_assets.description: The planned fox rear 0..1 (KD-016) for stretching up to the grapes at 7.36. Carry is not needed here.
new_assets.implementation: As planned by KD-016; fallback without it: raise 1 with tip -0.12 and the bunch hung lower (y 770).

owner_questions: The eating is not shown: at 122.9 the film cuts to the fox wincing while partridge feathers drift past (default: off-screen, with GULP! lettering).
The death of the falcon is shown as a fall, x eyes and feet in the air, with no blood or wound (default: this soft comic version).

Added comic business that is not in the script: crossed claws during the oath (72.86), the bare ground where grain was promised (69.28), the fox rolling his eyes in an inset (73.9) (default: keep all three).
Poison is shown as a green drop icon with an X and a green glow on the falcon belly rather than a skull (default: green drop).

English lettering invented for this film: GRAPES!, FALCON, PARTRIDGE, WHOOSH!, SCRATCH!, CAN'T REACH!, SHARP!, SAFE HERE, GRAB!, STRONG!, A TRICK!, POISON!, HA HA!, GULP!, EASY!, FLAP! FLAP!, THUD!, A LITTLE LATER..., THE END (default: keep; cut SAFE HERE and STRONG! first if it feels crowded).
The fox leaves by walking on to the right past the fallen falcon and the nest tree, not back the way he came (default: onward to the right, as "continued on its way").
The sky changes from day to dusk under the A LITTLE LATER... card although the script says only "soon" (default: dusk, to make the time jump visible and the ending sombre).
implementation_notes: World 1600 x 1230, ground y 900. The panel shows 1000 x 1230 at zoom 1, so the fox (x 220 to 330) and the snag (x 820) share a frame at cam x 500, and the snag and the nest tree share one at cam x 1100. Clamp the camera to the 1600 width.
Word cues: use w(p, n) from timing.json; every cue in this plan gives the script word and its start time on the final MP3.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so all three animals blink; give the falcon explicit lid values during the mask scenes and add hand blinks there.

Mask rule for the falcon: sweet face (raised brow, smile, lid 0.4 to 0.5, head tilts, feet hidden with sit) whenever the partridge can see him; real face (brow 1, smirk or closed beak, feet out) only when it looks away or after 88.86. Changes into the mask use settleTo; the mask drop at 88.86 is a 3-frame snap.
Fox walks: FX(t) = kfn keys, legs from walk(FX, t), dust and feather hops from footfalls(FX, ...). Entry -220 to 300 over 0.0 to 3.1; exit 330 to 1750 over 160.2 to 163.5 on a lane at y 880.
Bird flight: one bezier path function per flight (chase 12.0 to 16.7, loop 17.6 to 20.8, lift 95.9 to 98.2) returning x, y, rot and flap, in the manner of the Lark flyBz.
Pounce and fall use fallY with impactSquash and rebound; contact frames are covered by a 2-frame white flash; shake inside the panel clip only.
Draw order at the nook: tree, nook back twigs, nest back, partridge, nest front, nook front twigs, then the falcon and his reaching leg on top.

Sound effects only at 8.95, 20.5, 21.0, 24.1, 64.35, 81.3, 123.05, 143.45 and 164.2 (all in listed pauses or after the last word), SND master 0.6. The pounce at 93.12 and the impact at 144.5 are silent: flash, shake and lettering carry them.
The LATER card runs 130.0 to 131.2 over the words for "but soon"; swap the baked day background for the dusk one at its covered midpoint.
After approval move hawk and partridge kinds, grapeBunch, featherFall and the orchard pieces into Library/ with registry entries, then run node Library/tests/regression.mjs.
warnings: The narration has only seven pauses of 0.6 s or more, so the film is nearly silent apart from the voice; the big hits (pounce, fall) cannot have sound without covering words.
S11 (the curse) is 18.4 s on one small stage: it depends on acting and the three icons (heart, cracked heart, poison drop). If it drags in review, add one more cut to the falcon reaction at 116.2.
The falcon is the Library bird scaled to 1.9; line weights grow with scale. The hawk kind should draw with its own stroke widths so it matches the other characters.
A partly bald falcon (moult) must stay comic, not gruesome: pink patches with a few dots, no skin detail.
The word وأن at about 120.09 was not recognised by Whisper (interpolated time); no action is cued on it.
